01-carved-and-clean.how: Counted by a transcription of ResultView.tsx's own recursion (MAX_DEPTH = 3, LONG_TEXT = 320): one row per entry of every object it draws, none for a container at or past the depth cap. Depth counts containers, so the top-level object is 1.
